definitions.explanation: Love or affection directed unfairly toward one particular person or thing, at the expense of others. Implies a lack of balance, as when a parent favors one child or a person is obsessively fond of one thing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{偏愛|へんあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{偏愛|へんあい}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He is excessively fond of old watches.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{偏愛|へんあい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、ほか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{傷|きず}つく→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When a parent shows favoritism to one child, the other siblings can get hurt.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧ (biased, leaning) + ⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧ (love). Denotes unbalanced affection toward one person or thing. Used both as a noun and, with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, as a verb ({偏愛|へんあい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偏愛|へんあい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be excessively fond of; to favor
- ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{偏愛|へんあい}: a parent's favoritism
- ～⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{偏愛|へんあい}: excessive fondness for ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- えこひいき: favoritism — more colloquial; stresses unfair treatment of others
- ⟦{溺愛|できあい}→溺愛：16499_dekiai⟧: doting; smothering love — excessive love that spoils, especially toward children
